title: Direct browser load of a URL with malformed percent-encoding (e.g. /search?q=%E0%A4%A) returns a blank HTTP 500 from the Vite dev server before the app loads
area: apps/web dev server (vite 6.0.5); not app code. In-app navigation to the same URL renders fine (F4 PASS).
evidence: curl http://127.0.0.1:5411/search?q=%E0%A4%A -> 500; /search?q=abc -> 200; also 500 on /?q=%E0%A4%A. Playwright page body empty, console: 'Failed to load resource: 500'. Screenshot F4-malformed-percent.png.
fix_direction: Verify against the production static host/reverse proxy before treating as a product issue; dev-only otherwise. File-don't-fix.
